pages.text: Most mods explain themselves. What they don't explain is how they plug into each other. This section is about those joins.$(br2)Almost every connection in this pack runs through a few shared things.

$(li)$(thing)Rotation$() and $(thing)electricity$(), and the blocks that convert between them$(li)$(thing)Heat$(), mostly from the Blaze Burner$(li)$(thing)Liquid fuel$(), mostly from oil$(li)$(thing)Metals$() several mods share$(li)$(thing)Destinations$() for every vehicle

Each entry here is short and points to the full entries. Read it when you wonder "can this mod's thing go into that mod's machine?"$(br2)Also worth knowing: anything that burns makes smog, and anything hot warms you up. See $(l:connections/side_effects)Side Effects$(/l).
